title: Refining a presentation towards constructible sheaves on a site with enough quasi-compact objects
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter sites-modules.tex (Modules on Sites)

difficulty_reason: The lemma refines a given presentation by direct images of the structure sheaf along members of a basis into a presentation whose first terms are indexed by a finite set of intersections and coverings from the basis, in such a way that the horizontal maps induce an isomorphism on cokernels. The proof first uses quasi-compactness of the U_i to choose finite subfamilies of the given coverings, then uses surjectivity of the resulting map to find coverings of the V_j and a commutative diagram refining the presentation, and finally uses quasi-compactness of the V_j again to cut those coverings down to finite subfamilies, defining the index set L as a disjoint union of products of the finite index sets and of the V-indexed finite sets and choosing the corresponding basis members as intersections (proof lines 5583-5624). H2: the two successive applications of the quasi-compact refinement and the construction of the index set L with the intersections are the substance.
